existingDispositions.rationale: Fatigue could impair goal-directed control, but cited framework/remediation sources do not isolate exact BIO-026 state from subjective effort, task exposure or PSY-080 performance.
External recommendation detail and internal action-plan specificity are distinct analytic units; uptake, comprehension and opportunity are required.

Monitoring can change perceived-current information before corrective behavior. The RDS then recalculates; later progress toward a target is not the same operation. For a signed discrepancy, approach to zero is not universal NEGATIVE polarity.
BFI-2 construct validation and Big Five academic-performance prediction do not directly test conscientiousness causing monitoring intensity.
Visible tracking is an affordance; deliberate attended comparison is the Psychological target. NIST AI RMF is not exact behavioral efficacy evidence.

gapQuestions.rationale: EA0016 retains synthesis support for monitoring frequency but exact reusable prompt protocol/attention alignment unresolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Monitoring necessarily decreases signed goal discrepancy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Revealed information may increase gap; approach to zero can increase a negative value. Formula updating is not independent causal propagation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Desired/reference and perceived current inputs derive PSY-078.
gapQuestions.rationale: Already encoded required external inputs. No invented constituent Driver or duplicate binary edge; scenario specification remains needed.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Monitoring → discrepancy → goal attainment is a causal pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Meta-analytic mediation and theory do not identify transmitted pathway with exact RDS scope, timing and endpoints.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Forming if-then plan increases implementation intention strength.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reuse HT0014 only; manipulation assignment/plan production not strength or commitment measurement.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Implementation intention equals action.
gapQuestions.rationale: Plans and realized behavior differ; engaged gym participants still showed no positive attendance effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Guided external recommendations produce more specific internal plans.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing INF-043 revision path; intervention-arm selected plan writers do not isolate causal transmission.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Low negative expectancies associate with more specific plans.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reinwand selected uptake and action-plan coding require exact PSY-004 outcome-probability alignment; no formal new association.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Specificity automatically proves instrumentality or feasibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: What/when/where/how content can be specific yet infeasible; content quality dimensions differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Affect-regulation training raises PSY-079 capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Multi-skill package and past-week composite, not momentary whole capacity; waitlist and active controls differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: ART proves any single reappraisal component improves capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Package effect cannot be assigned to a component; no fidelity/strategy isolate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Emotion skills mediate training effect on depression.
gapQuestions.rationale: Postrandomization mediator and outcome share reports; intervention randomization does not randomize mediator.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Emotion regulation capacity equals reappraisal preference.
gapQuestions.rationale: Current ability differs from habitual strategy use and goals; regulation may increase an emotion.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Repeated GNG practice increases response inhibition capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA0017 RN due go-speed/transfer proxies, protocol heterogeneity and active-control results.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Faster go responses prove stronger inhibition.
gapQuestions.rationale: Response initiation speed is not stopping/withholding; training can favor go trials.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Food intake reduction proves general self-control capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Stimulus devaluation, learned cue association and task-specific withholding are alternatives to broad capacity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Prior exertion depletes current self-control capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Preserve small positive Stroop-antisaccade replication and confirmatory multisite nondetection, not a universal resource model.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A depletion-task effect proves a finite physiological self-control resource.
gapQuestions.rationale: Task-sequence effect cannot identify latent substrate; fatigue, motivation, strategy and expectations remain alternatives.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Sleep loss reduces response inhibition.
gapQuestions.rationale: Healthy GNG/SST synthesis supports bounded impairment, but exact canonical BIO source/protocol and capacity measurement need reconciliation; reuse existing sleep-loss HT, no BIO-F01 work.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Attentional control, inhibition and working-memory availability are identical.
gapQuestions.rationale: Related tasks/processes are not semantic identity; interference suppression differs from stopping initiated action.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Motivation moderates exact BIO-019 fatigue-control effect.
gapQuestions.rationale: Theory and measured fatigue moderators are not independent exact-edge causal evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Coping training changes PSY-083.
gapQuestions.rationale: Chinese workplace packages and self-report scores need exact capacity and active-comparator followup; no component efficacy.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Coping flexibility equals coping repertoire or cognitive flexibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Fit, repertoire, switching and perceived ability differ in definition and association magnitude.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cultural individualism changes coping-flexibility benefits.
gapQuestions.rationale: Country-level meta-moderator is observational/ecological, not exact cultural Driver or governed edge interaction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Social support increases usable self-control or coping capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Social contact/context plausible; no sufficiently aligned randomized exact Driver contrast extracted here.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Noise/environmental disruption lowers attentional control.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reuse F06 noise synthesis; broad cognitive performance is not current PSY-080, task-specific direction remains.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Institutional schedules or rules improve planning/monitoring.
gapQuestions.rationale: Opportunity and compliance requirements are not internal uptake; selected training studies do not isolate policy effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A platform tracking occurrence proves self-monitoring.
gapQuestions.rationale: Data availability, access and attended comparison are separate. No occurrence-to-consequence shortcut.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: One short training permanently improves conscientiousness.
gapQuestions.rationale: Current state versus stable disposition/time scale; no trait change identified.
